svg.title: Splunk SOC Lab — 09-ubuntu-preflight annotated
svg.desc: Point-in-time Ubuntu preflight checks include two active service states, Auditd lost=0, file/process audit rules loaded, and a running Splunk Forwarder; not proof of long-term health.

g.text: SSH / Auditd active · lost=0 · auditing rules present · Splunk forwarder running
